title: Carolina Hurricanes Move Within Victory of Stanley Cup Final
text:
The Carolina Hurricanes took a 3-1 lead in the Eastern Conference Final by beating the Montreal Canadiens 4-0 in Game 4, with Sebastian Aho, Jordan Staal, and Logan Stankoven scoring in a 2:47 span late in the first period.
MONTREAL - Sebastian Aho, Jordan Staal and Logan Stankoven scored in a 2:47 span late in the first period and the Carolina Hurricanes moved within a victory of the Stanley Cup Final , beating the Montreal Canadiens 4-0 on Wednesday night.
Frederik Andersen made 18 saves for his third shutout in 12 postseason games this year to help the Hurricanes take a 3-1 lead in the Eastern Conference Final. Carolina's Jordan Staal scored on goalie Jakub Dobes during the Canadiens' 4-0 Game 4 win over the Hurricanes on May 27, 2026 in Montreal. They put it away early in Game 4 after winning the previous two games in overtime.
Sebastian Aho celebrated his goal with Carolina teammates Andrei Svechnikov, Nikolaj Ehlers and Shayne Gostisbehere during the first period of the Hurricanes' Game 4 win over the Canadiens. The Hurricanes scored first for the fourth straight game when Aho beat Jakub Dobes with a one-timer from the right circle on a power play with 5:02 left in the first. Stankoven then finished off a two-on-one with Jason Blake with 2:14 remaining in the period.
Carolina had a 19-3 shots-on-goal advantage in the third period for a 43-18 overall edge
